title: ResearchTranscript
description:
ResearchTranscript turns interviews, group discussions and field recordings into transcripts for qualitative research. Speech recognition (whisper.cpp) and speaker diarisation (SpeakerKit with pyannote models) run locally on the Mac; no recording or text leaves the computer. The transcript is checked and corrected in an editor with waveform, keyboard control and memos, and exported as WebVTT, CSV, text, Markdown, Word, REFI-QDA (.qdpx) or an enrich dossier.

For each transcript the app generates a documentation package for researchers: a transcription record with the models used and the measured degree of manual editing, a paragraph for the methods section, facts for records of processing and ethics applications, and a repository data sheet following the Zenodo form and DataCite.

macOS 14 or later, Apple silicon. Interface in German, English, French and Italian.
